description:
Title: Ordering in an Online Shop  

A customer that logs into an E-Shop system and has to wait for its login confirmation (its credentials are checked by the system).
If the login was successful then the customer can continue to select products, else the shopping experience stops.
After selecting a product the customer has to add it to a shopping cart, save the product and check if every product was already selected.
These steps repeat until all products were selected.
Then the order is finished by the shopping system and simultaneously payment and shipment for the order is prepared.
For the payment the customer has to enter its payment data and has to wait until the bank confirms the payment.
While waiting for the payment confirmation the customer can enter its shipping address (an independent billing address can be entered if the shipping address is not equal to the billing address).
Finally if the address and the payment steps are executed then the order will be finished by the system.

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_OnlineShop" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/online-shop">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_LoginRequest" name="Login request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_LoginConfirmed" name="Login confirmed"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_LoginRejected" name="Login rejected"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_OrderSubmitted" name="Order submitted"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_PaymentData" name="Payment data"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_PaymentConfirmed" name="Payment confirmed"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_AddressPaymentCompleted" name="Address and payment completed"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_OnlineShop">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_EShopSystem" name="E-Shop System" processRef="Process_EShopSystem"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Bank" name="Bank"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_LoginRequest" name="Login request" sourceRef="SendTask_SendLogin" targetRef="StartEvent_LoginRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_LoginConfirmed" name="Login confirmed" sourceRef="SendTask_LoginConfirm" targetRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_LoginConfirmed"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_LoginRejected" name="Login rejected" sourceRef="SendTask_LoginReject" targetRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_LoginRejected"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_OrderSubmitted" name="Order submitted" sourceRef="SendTask_SubmitOrder" targetRef="StartEvent_OrderSubmitted"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_PaymentData" name="Payment data" sourceRef="SendTask_SendPayment" targetRef="Participant_Bank"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_PaymentConfirmed" name="Payment confirmed" sourceRef="Participant_Bank" targetRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_PaymentConfirmed"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_AddressPaymentCompleted" name="Address and payment completed" sourceRef="SendTask_SendCompletion" targetRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_AddressPaymentReceived"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Customer" name="Start shopping"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_Login" name="Log in with credentials"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendLogin" name="Send login request"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="EventBasedGateway_LoginResult" name="Login result"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatchEvent_LoginConfirmed" name="Login confirmation received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_LoginConfirmed" messageRef="Msg_LoginConfirmed"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatchEvent_LoginRejected" name="Login rejection received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_LoginRejected" messageRef="Msg_LoginRejected"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ShoppingStopped" name="Shopping stopped"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SelectionMerge" name="Next product"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_SelectProduct" name="Select product"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_AddToCart" name="Add product to shopping cart"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SaveProduct" name="Save product"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckAllSelected" name="Check whether every product was selected"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AllSelected" name="All products selected?" default="Flow_ProductsRemaining"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SubmitOrder" name="Submit order"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PaymentShippingSplit" name="Start payment and address steps"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_EnterPayment" name="Enter payment data"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendPayment" name="Send payment data to bank"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatchEvent_PaymentConfirmed" name="Payment confirmation received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_PaymentConfirmed" messageRef="Msg_PaymentConfirmed"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_EnterShipping" name="Enter shipping address"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BillingSplit" name="Billing address differs from shipping address?" default="Flow_BillingSame"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_EnterBilling" name="Enter independent billing address"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BillingMerge" name="Billing address handled"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PaymentShippingJoin" name="Payment and address steps done"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendCompletion" name="Send address and payment completion"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_CustomerDone" name="Customer steps completed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C01" sourceRef="StartEvent_Customer" targetRef="UserTask_Login"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C02" sourceRef="UserTask_Login" targetRef="SendTask_SendLogin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C03" sourceRef="SendTask_SendLogin" targetRef="EventBasedGateway_LoginResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C04" sourceRef="EventBasedGateway_LoginResult" targetRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_LoginConfirmed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C05" sourceRef="EventBasedGateway_LoginResult" targetRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_LoginRejected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C06" sourceRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_LoginRejected" targetRef="EndEvent_ShoppingStopped"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C07" sourceRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_LoginConfirmed" targetRef="Gateway_SelectionMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C08" sourceRef="Gateway_SelectionMerge" targetRef="UserTask_SelectProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C09" sourceRef="UserTask_SelectProduct" targetRef="UserTask_AddToCart"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C10" sourceRef="UserTask_AddToCart" targetRef="Task_SaveProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C11" sourceRef="Task_SaveProduct" targetRef="Task_CheckAllSelected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C12" sourceRef="Task_CheckAllSelected" targetRef="Gateway_AllSelected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AllSelected" sourceRef="Gateway_AllSelected" targetRef="SendTask_SubmitOrder">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${allProductsSelected}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ProductsRemaining" sourceRef="Gateway_AllSelected" targetRef="Gateway_SelectionMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C15" sourceRef="SendTask_SubmitOrder" targetRef="Gateway_PaymentShippingSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C16" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentShippingSplit" targetRef="UserTask_EnterPayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C17" sourceRef="UserTask_EnterPayment" targetRef="SendTask_SendPayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C18" sourceRef="SendTask_SendPayment" targetRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_PaymentConfirmed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C19" sourceRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_PaymentConfirmed" targetRef="Gateway_PaymentShippingJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C20" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentShippingSplit" targetRef="UserTask_EnterShipping"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C21" sourceRef="UserTask_EnterShipping" targetRef="Gateway_BillingSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BillingDiffers" sourceRef="Gateway_BillingSplit" targetRef="UserTask_EnterBilling">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${billingAddressDiffers}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BillingSame" sourceRef="Gateway_BillingSplit" targetRef="Gateway_BillingMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C24" sourceRef="UserTask_EnterBilling" targetRef="Gateway_BillingMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C25" sourceRef="Gateway_BillingMerge" targetRef="Gateway_PaymentShippingJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C26" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentShippingJoin" targetRef="SendTask_SendCompletion"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C27" sourceRef="SendTask_SendCompletion" targetRef="EndEvent_CustomerDone"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_EShopSystem" name="E-Shop System" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_LoginRequest" name="Login request received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_LoginRequest" messageRef="Msg_LoginRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CheckCredentials" name="Check login credentials"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CredentialsValid" name="Credentials valid?" default="Flow_CredentialsInvalid"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_LoginConfirm" name="Send login confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_LoginReject" name="Send login rejection"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_LoginDone" name="Login completed"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_LoginRejected" name="Login rejected"/>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_OrderSubmitted" name="Order submitted">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_OrderSubmitted" messageRef="Msg_OrderSubmitted"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_FinishOrder" name="Finish order"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PrepSplit" name="Start payment and shipment preparation"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_PreparePayment" name="Prepare payment"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_PrepareShipment" name="Prepare shipment"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PrepJoin" name="Payment and shipment prepared"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatchEvent_AddressPaymentReceived" name="Address and payment completed received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_AddressPaymentCompleted" messageRef="Msg_AddressPaymentCompleted"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CompleteOrder" name="Complete order"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_OrderCompleted" name="Order completed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S01" sourceRef="StartEvent_LoginRequest" targetRef="Task_CheckCredentials"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S02" sourceRef="Task_CheckCredentials" targetRef="Gateway_CredentialsValid"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CredentialsValid" sourceRef="Gateway_CredentialsValid" targetRef="SendTask_LoginConfirm">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${credentialsValid}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CredentialsInvalid" sourceRef="Gateway_CredentialsValid" targetRef="SendTask_LoginReject"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S05" sourceRef="SendTask_LoginConfirm" targetRef="EndEvent_LoginDone"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S06" sourceRef="SendTask_LoginReject" targetRef="EndEvent_LoginRejected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S07" sourceRef="StartEvent_OrderSubmitted" targetRef="Task_FinishOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S08" sourceRef="Task_FinishOrder" targetRef="Gateway_PrepSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S09" sourceRef="Gateway_PrepSplit" targetRef="Task_PreparePayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S10" sourceRef="Gateway_PrepSplit" targetRef="Task_PrepareShipment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S11" sourceRef="Task_PreparePayment" targetRef="Gateway_PrepJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S12" sourceRef="Task_PrepareShipment" targetRef="Gateway_PrepJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S13" sourceRef="Gateway_PrepJoin" targetRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_AddressPaymentReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S14" sourceRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_AddressPaymentReceived" targetRef="Task_CompleteOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S15" sourceRef="Task_CompleteOrder" targetRef="EndEvent_OrderCompleted"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
